Callout.Name: Street Robbery
Callout.Message: Street robbery just happened, victim still on scene.
Callout.Advisory: Two suspects on foot, phone and wallet taken.

Script.Line: Two of them. One in front and one behind.
They took the phone and the watch. That is all they took.
I am not hurt. I am shaken up, I am not hurt.

Lines.Approach: Two of them, took the phone and ran. The victim is still there and shaken.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
